scope: Reviewer 1 item 6: genuine cross-setting adaptation and local-data learning curves, limited to the existing name/context/literal-unit-reviewed WHU-MIMIC four laboratory matrices. No OMOP, relabeling, prospective-event, three-centre harmonization or clinical minimum-sample-size assertion.
source_model: Previously fitted full-source 50:50 XGBoost/random-forest ensemble_median; serialized packages are frozen and no source model is refitted

MIMIC.label: Original frozen same-admission label retaining original survivor restriction

aggregation: Existing all-accessible patient-linked WHU and admission-linked MIMIC accepted-measurement medians; no verified pre-event or result-availability cutoff
outer_evaluation: Exact five patient-isolated outer-test roles preserved from the 2026-10-15 matrices via the 2026-10-16 common arrays. All other patients form the target adaptation pool for that fold; source cohorts are institution-namespaced, not linked by coincident numeric identifiers.

target_sampling.rule: For each target and outer fold, patient max-label defines proportional strata within the labelled target outer-training pool. For each repeat, fixed independently permuted stratum orders generate nested prefixes at all three sizes. Positive-patient quota is round(n times pool positive-patient proportion), constrained to 1 through n-1. This is stratified sampling from an already labelled pool, not a prospective label-acquisition study. No outer-test labels or performance influence draws.
target_sampling.mimic: Sample patients, retain all admissions of selected patients; sample size is not an admission count
target_sampling.seed_derivation: numpy default_rng SeedSequence([repeat_seed, target_index, fold_number]), target_index WHU=0 and MIMIC=1
target_sampling.reuse: Exactly the same selected patients/admissions are used by all four adaptation/local methods

models.direct_source: Frozen full-source ensemble predictions, unchanged across sample sizes and repeats
models.platt_unconstrained: Unweighted, unpenalized intercept+slope logistic regression of target label on source probability logit, clipped to [1e-6,1-1e-6]. Negative slopes are permitted and explicitly reported as ranking reversal, not order-preserving calibration.
models.logistic_update_source_transform: L2 C=1 unweighted logistic regression with intercept on source logit plus four values. Source-only medians and mean/standard deviation fit on full source inputs, including source-model logits on source records; no target-side transform fitting.
models.local_logistic_source_transform: L2 C=1 unweighted logistic regression using the four values with source-only medians/standardization. This is not a source-independent local baseline.
models.local_logistic_target_transform: L2 C=1 unweighted logistic regression using four values, with medians and standardization fitted only on the selected target training observations; all-empty selected column falls back to 0 and is reported. This is the fully target-local preprocessing comparator.

weights: Fit and evaluation retain the original row/admission weighting; repeated MIMIC admissions are not silently patient-averaged. Patient grouping governs sampling, isolation and bootstrap clustering.
platt_failure_rules: Before fitting: fail if training has one class, constant logit, or complete/quasi separation of the two class logit ranges. After fitting: fail on a convergence warning, nonfinite coefficient/prediction or nonconvergence. No test-selected fallback or arbitrary slope clipping. A failed fold makes that repeat/size Platt full-OOF result unavailable; do not score only surviving folds. Other fixed L2 models similarly fail on nonconvergence/nonfinite outputs. Report failures explicitly.

evaluation.primary: Full original target denominator. For each size/repeat, concatenate only predictions from that patient's own outer-test fold and evaluate once. Do not concatenate repeats as independent rows.
evaluation.repeat_summary: Report arithmetic mean and min/max of the three repeat-level metrics. Mean-metric bootstrap intervals use the same target-patient draw across all three repeats and take the mean of the three recalculated metrics. Require all three complete repeats. No probability averaging; this is not a probability-ensemble estimand.
evaluation.coverage_secondary: Predeclared secondary no-refit evaluation among target observations with at least one finite accepted lab in the frozen raw-NaN matrix; retain original source and adaptation fits, labels and predictions. It is conditional on coverage and does not establish clinical test ordering or disease absence. Main denominator is unchanged.

bootstrap.unit: target patient cluster, retaining all eligible admissions and common weights across methods/sizes/repeats
bootstrap.interval: Nominal percentile 95%, conditional on frozen source models, selected target training samples, extracted matrices and observed coverage; excludes refitting/source-sampling/target-draw selection and multiplicity uncertainty

source_availability_warning: WHU has 318 all-four-missing patients including 102 original positives; coverage restriction is an important secondary estimand, not a mechanistic fix. MIMIC total protein is observed in only 795 admissions.
forbidden_claims: equivalent clinical tasks or complete assay/platform equivalence
minimum clinically acceptable local sample size
semantic drift or access as identified mechanism
privacy: Patient keys, rows, role membership, selected indices and predictions remain private. Public logs and reports contain only aggregate counts, coefficients and file/array hashes.
artifacts: Private 90 direction/fold/size/repeat packages containing all four fitted adapters and patient-isolated roles; private complete OOF arrays; public training manifest, fold counts, calibration coefficients, repeat and mean/range metrics, paired differences, fixed-bootstrap intervals, tests, input/output identities and independently executable package/score replay. No old output is modified.
